## What changes

One feature per pull request. Say what and why in a few lines.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy --strict src tests benchmarks` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] `python scripts/reproduce_readme.py --check` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/make_examples.py --check` passes
- [ ] Synthetic data only

Outside code contributions are not accepted. Bug reports by issue are fine.
